description: This file defines a Database class implementing data storage and retrieval using AsyncStorage, with methods for managing payloads, keys, and load chunks, within a React Native environment.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with a key-value storage for payload data, including retrieval, deletion, and chunked loading.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Database instance with an identifier, setting up metadata storage.

methods.name: databaseKeyForPayloadId
methods.description: Generates a storage key for a given payload ID.

methods.name: getDatabaseKeyPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for database keys, based on the identifier.

methods.name: getAllEntries
methods.description: Retrieves all payload entries from storage.

methods.name: getAllKeys
methods.description: Fetches all keys from storage that match the database prefix.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a specific item by UUID.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all items in the database.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Stores multiple payload items into storage.

methods.name: getLoadChunks
methods.description: Retrieves load chunks based on options, including sorting and migration.

methods.name: multiGet
methods.description: Retrieves multiple items by keys, handling platform-specific errors.
